topic: Data requests for analytics and mapping
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several data points. Initially, [p1] requested a review of dashboard data covering lidar impressions in Brazil and Germany. Later, [p1] inquired about historical sample data (e.g., raw sensor data or session examples) for Kantar, specifically asking if simple database extractions of sessions by vendors, real locations, and malls were available.

Separately, [me] requested a mapping of 2D lidar to facilities, preferably using `lidarId`. [p1] confirmed having the data but provided a list detailing the installation order rather than the full map.
decisions: Dashboard review needed for lidar impressions in Brazil and Germany.
action_items: [p1] to provide the requested 2D lidar-to-facility mapping data.
